The sandbox has the same API and response shapes, but it is rate-limited to 2 messages per second and capped at 500 messages a day for the whole team, so do not loop over large fixtures. Bounces and complaints are simulated with magic addresses from the provider's docs. Important: the sandbox silently drops (answers 202, never delivers) every message whose recipient is not on the `@sink.acme.test` domain, so a test that asserts delivery must send to an address such as `receipts@sink.acme.test` and read it back from the sink inbox API.","physical":["services/notifier/"],"logical":["notifier"],"tags":["notifier","email","testing"],"criticality":0.5,"confidence":0.8,"status":"active","visibility":"shared","provenance":"human","epistemic":"fact"}
